content.comment_body: Hello! I'm looking to control the starting and stopping of a [product_name] [article_no] via Ethernet commands, specifically using [product_name] Monitor. Is this achievable? Any guidance or examples would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]
[product_name] Monitor does not support the ability to start or stop the [product_name]. The only way to achieve this over Ethernet is by using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
Hello [user_name], Please check [url] for an example of remote control using .Net. Hope this is helpful. Good luck.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to start and stop a [product_name] device remotely via Ethernet, using [product_name] Monitor. However, it's clarified that [product_name] Monitor lacks this functionality. The recommended solution is to use [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], and an alternative involving .Net is also suggested, showing possible workarounds with third-party programming.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants to easily start and stop a [product_name] device remotely by Ethernet commands using [product_name] Monitor, hoping for clear software support and helpful examples.
